about: The Notebook search box's labelled set (wave 10, lane 10E-1, clause 13c): a synthetic trader corpus -- no member's words -- and queries labelled with the notes a member searching them wants. Relevance is binary; `kind` says what each query tests, so a paraphrase or a typo the lexical search cannot find is a measured miss, not an omitted query. Measured by tools/notebook_search_recall.py.

notes.title: NVDA earnings preview Q3
body: Data center revenue is the whole story this quarter.
Guidance above consensus would keep the base intact.

notes.title: Nvidia long thesis
body: The GPU franchise and the CUDA moat keep margins high.
Invalidation: a close below the 50 day average on heavy volume.

notes.title: AMD earnings preview
body: Client segment recovery and MI300 ramp are what matters.
Expected move is about eight percent.

notes.title: TSLA trade review
body: Entered on the reclaim of the 20 EMA, stopped out the next morning.
Lesson: do not buy the first bounce in a downtrend.

notes.title: Tesla deliveries note
body: Quarterly deliveries missed the whisper number.
Watching $TSLA for a gap fill toward the prior base.

notes.title: VCP setup checklist
body: Three or more contractions, each shallower than the last.
Volume dried up on the pullback before the pivot.

notes.title: Cup and handle on MSFT
body: A textbook cup and handle forming over eleven weeks.
Handle holds above the 10 week line.

notes.title: Stop loss discipline rules
body: Never widen a stop once the trade is on.
Risk no more than one percent of the account per position.

notes.title: Position sizing worksheet
body: Size equals account risk divided by the distance to the stop.
Half size in a correction, full size in a confirmed uptrend.

notes.title: FOMC minutes reaction
body: Rates held; the dot plot shifted one cut later.
Growth names sold off into the close then recovered.

notes.title: CPI print prep
body: Core inflation is the number the market trades.
Plan: no new positions until the first hour settles.

notes.title: Breakout journal AVGO
body: Breakout above the flat base on twice average volume.
Added on the first pullback to the breakout level.

notes.title: Failed breakout lessons
body: The breakout reversed the same day and closed below the pivot.
Cut it at the day low, loss was small.

notes.title: Earnings gap up plan CRM
body: Gap up after earnings; watching the opening range high.
An opening range breakout entry with the stop at the day low.

notes.title: Sector rotation notes
body: Money rotating out of semis into energy and utilities.
Relative strength line of XLE turning up.

notes.title: Semis weakness watch
body: SMH lost the 50 day; leaders like NVDA and AVGO holding up better.
Expect chop until the index reclaims its average.

notes.title: Daily note 2026-09-25
body: Market opened weak, bought the dip in META at support.
Journal: patience paid off today.

notes.title: Daily note 2026-09-24
body: Choppy session; no trades taken.
Reviewed the watch list and trimmed the laggards.

notes.title: META long thesis
body: Ad pricing recovery and cost discipline drive earnings growth.
Risk: regulatory headlines.

notes.title: AAPL short idea
body: Services growth slowing while the multiple stays high.
Short only below the 200 day average.

notes.title: When I trim a winner
body: Trim a third into strength after a three day run.
Trimmed the position in SMCI after the climax volume day.

notes.title: Pre-market routine
body: Check futures, the economic calendar and overnight news.
Mark the prior day high and low on the watch list.

notes.title: Market breadth dashboard read
body: Percent of stocks above the 50 day fell to thirty.
Breadth divergence while the index holds near highs.

notes.title: IPO base on ARM
body: First base after the IPO, eight weeks, tight closes.
Buy point is the high of the handle.

notes.title: Dividend stocks watch
body: Utilities and staples with rising dividends.
A defensive rotation candidate list.

notes.title: Options hedge plan
body: Buy puts on QQQ as a portfolio hedge into the event.
Size the hedge to one percent of the account.

notes.title: Trading psychology notes
body: Revenge trading after a loss is the costliest habit.
Walk away after two losing trades in a row.

notes.title: Gold miners setup
body: GDX forming a higher low as gold makes new highs.
Watching for the 20 EMA reclaim.

notes.title: Crude oil inventory note
body: A large inventory draw pushed crude above resistance.
Energy names like XOM followed through.

notes.title: Bank earnings season
body: JPM kicked off earnings with a beat on net interest income.
Regional banks lagged.
